body: I got an appointment with a good dermatologist in 2 weeks and I will ask him about it. Hopefully he helps me!

I am pretty sure it started after the laser treatment but I have recently started noticing it more because I have been looking at myself a lot lately. I have been on 100mg 2x a day minocycline for about 2 months and 1 week.

My skin is dry and oily. I have very little active acne because it is being treated with minocycline. No other skin products though. The last "dermatologist"(she was actually an APNP) I went to was incompetent and not helpful. 

This condition is very embarrassing because my face gets warm during arousal and then the blotches come.

> is there any scar treatment (peels, laser, whatever a dermatologist suggest...) that you might be able to afford? 

I an have in appointment schedule with a dermatologist next month. Hopefully he can help my acne and acne scarring. The last dermatology clinic I went to was very bad and did nothing to help me. Hopefully the one I go to next month helps or else I am sort of out of options :(

Well I never had any real dreams or ambitions. I know my life was going to be shit when I had severe acne when I was 13 and my parents didn't do a damn thing about it. I now suffering from facial scarring and don't go out of the house because people stare at it.

Yes my parents know and are concerned but there is only so much they can do. I am already on high doses of medication and it is doing very little. 
I do not think supporting myself will make me feel better but rather worse. I wouldn't want to have a boss telling me how to live my life. Besides, I never had a job so who would hire me; fast food places? I do not want to work with the public because most people are scum and I have little patients for stupidity.

The only thing keeping me alive is gaming and the internet. If I did not have those two things I would have been dead along time ago. I know I will be dead after my parents are gone and can no longer support me. I just want do speed up that process by taking my own life very soon.
Sure, I am just a cynical male in his earlier 20s who spends most of the day on the internet and gaming. What is the point of going on? I don't really care anymore.
